title.narrative: Safeguarding Indigenous Knowledge and Cultures for Equity and Inclusion

description.narrative: This project supports Member States and Indigenous Peoples to safeguard and promote Indigenous knowledge, cultures and languages through a human rights‑based approach grounded in dignity, equality and participation. It responds to threats from environmental change and social marginalisation. The project aims to strengthen inclusive policies and mainstream Indigenous perspectives across the implementation of culture standard‑setting instruments. Key activities include policy support, promotion of Indigenous languages, improved access to digital tools, and scaling up proven initiatives. It will deliver enhanced capacities, practical policy tools, and stronger transmission and visibility of Indigenous heritage and expressions.
